MILESTONE: Major curation pipeline overhaul implemented and bug-fixed.

SHIPPED:
- Existing memories fed into curator prompt (engine.buildExistingMemoriesContext → server → curator)
- Curation prompt rewritten: removed 'consciousness engineering' preamble, kept retrieval algorithm + schema + templates
- event_date and supersedes fields added to schema, types, store
- Global scope routing fixed: scope:'global' memories now go to store.storeGlobalMemory()
- Supersedes support: curator can output supersedes field, engine marks old memory as superseded
- Manager rewritten as deterministic dedup (3 rules: domain+feature+headline overlap, state dedup, tag linking)
- Model switched: claude-opus-4-5-20251101 → claude-sonnet-4-6
- Cross-segment dedup: accumulated headlines passed to later segments

FILES MODIFIED:
- src/types/memory.ts (event_date, supersedes fields)
- src/types/schema.ts (event_date in memorySchema)
- src/core/store.ts (pass event_date, updateGlobalMemory(), updateMemory supports superseded_by+related_to)
- src/core/engine.ts (global routing, supersedes handler, buildExistingMemoriesContext, getStore)
- src/core/curator.ts (all methods accept existingMemories, prompt rewrite, segment dedup, sonnet model)
- src/core/manager.ts (complete rewrite — deterministic, no LLM)
- src/server/index.ts (build context before curator calls, use new manager API)
- src/cli/commands/ingest.ts (updated to new manager API, collect IDs from return values)

ENABLES: Dedup-aware extraction, inline supersession, correct global routing going forward
